title: The Causal Boundary
core_thesis: The causal boundary separates idempotent digital computation from irreversible physical reality, dictating that AI in physical systems cannot rely on software exception handling and must guarantee physical safety before commanding actuation.
pedagogical_strengths: Vivid contrast between digital idempotency and physical momentum clearly establishes why physical AI requires stricter invariants than software AI.
The taxonomy of Four Machine Archetypes successfully distills diverse robotic form factors into shared underlying physical conservation laws.

student_friction_points.point: The summary introduces dense architectural abstractions like 'Proposal-Permission Contract' and 'Three-Pillar Scope Test'. If not progressively unpacked in the main text, these risk summary overload before intuitive grounding.

The transition from 'software threads' to 'memory-mapped actuator registers' happens very quickly; bridging the hardware-software interface (e.g., PCIe to PWM) explicitly would smooth this cognitive leap.

established_budgets_and_laws: Unguided Displacement (Inelastic Latency drift): Δx = ∫v dt
Kinetic stopping envelopes and momentum conservation: v² / 2a_max
Structural impedance limits for Class 2 systems: kΔx
Thermodynamic irreversibility across the boundary: Joule heating (I²R)
imported_prerequisites: Foundational Newtonian physics (kinetic energy, momentum, rigid body dynamics).
Standard computer systems architecture (exception handling, memory-mapped I/O, idempotency).
exported_concepts: The Four Machine Archetypes (Mass, Contact, Flow, Integrative).

surgical_edits.target_text: A robot approaching an obstacle continues traveling while its software processes observations, and any delay leaves less distance available for stopping.
surgical_edits.improved_text: As a robot's software processes observations, its physical chassis continues coasting toward an obstacle. Every millisecond of computational delay consumes physical space, irreversibly shrinking the available braking envelope.

surgical_edits.target_text: Advisory software operates inside an informational container where errors carry negligible physical momentum.
surgical_edits.improved_text: Advisory software operates within an informational sandbox where computational errors carry no physical momentum and incur no thermodynamic cost.

open_thematic_threads_for_part: How does the hardware anatomy mathematically enforce the safety boundaries that the cognitive brain's neural policies are inherently unable to guarantee?
